LESSON: HADITH ON IMAN

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HADITH 4.1 Hadith on swalah By the end of the sub-strand the  Learners in group
Topic 4.2: Hadith on Iman

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Hadith on Iman. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: how generosity to his  Learners to read repeatedly the Hadith on neighbours class?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Outline ways through which a muslim can show generosity to his neighbor.
2. Appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of social cohesion. amongst them.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Outline ways through which a muslim can show generosity to his neighbor.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to outline ways through which a muslim can show generosity to his neighbor. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of social cohesion. amongst them.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of social cohesion. amongst them. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Hadith on Iman.
2. Explain Hadith on Iman to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hadith on Iman.
4. Show that you can: Outline ways through which a muslim can show generosity to his neighbor.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Iman. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: how generosity to his  Learners to read repeatedly the Hadith on neighbours class?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Outline ways through which a muslim can show generosity to his neighbor.
2. Appreciate the virtue of generosity as a means of social cohesion. amongst them.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
